meta.name: FIFA+
meta.description:
Bringing fans into the heart of football with the iconic World Cup Archive, Live football from around the globe and documentaries bring the stories behind the beautiful game.

Shows: World Champions: France 1998, Argentina v Serbia and Montenegro | Group C | 2006 FIFA World Cup Germany™ | Full Match Replay, Netherlands v Argentina | Semi-finals | 2014 FIFA World Cup Brazil™ | Full Match Replay, Brazil v France | Quarter-finals | 2006 FIFA World Cup Germany™ | Full Match Replay, FACTS: Spain v England | Australia/New Zealand 2023
Available on: Samsung TV Plus, Plex
